component.title: Cartesian Charts
component.purpose: Present version progression with a readable chart and tabular equivalent.

claims.statement: The chart plot is named and present.
claims.rationale: The reusable chart is rendered as three named instances on the dashboard; the page-level machine contract verifies the composed trend surface, while this single-instance component claim is manually attested because the route capture cannot select one instance without collapsing the repeated series.

claims.statement: Every plotted value has an accessible tabular equivalent.
